title: One Piece
notes: A young pirate captain, Monkey D. Luffy, and his diverse crew set sail across the grand seas to find the legendary One Piece treasure and become the Pirate King.

title: Dr. Stone
notes: Thousands of years after a mysterious phenomenon turns all of humanity to stone, a genius high school student wakes up and vows to rebuild civilization using science.

title: Demon Slayer
notes: After his family is brutally attacked by demons and his sister is transformed into one, a kind-hearted boy trains to become a demon slayer to cure his sister and avenge his family.

title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid
notes: An ordinary office worker's life is turned upside down when a powerful, shapeshifting dragon she saved the previous night arrives at her apartment to work as her maid.

title: Your Name.
notes: Two high school students, a girl in a rural town and a boy in Tokyo, wake up to discover they have mysteriously swapped bodies, sparking a deep and supernatural connection.

title: Your Lie in April
notes: A former piano prodigy who lost the ability to hear his own music after his mother's death meets a free-spirited violinist who helps him face the piano once again.

title: Weathering with You
notes: A high school runaway in a rain-soaked Tokyo meets an orphan girl who possesses the mysterious ability to clear the weather and summon the sun.

title: Spy x Family
notes: A master spy must construct a fake family for a mission, unaware that the wife he marries is a professional assassin and the daughter he adopts is a telepath who knows their secrets.

title: Business Proposal
notes: An employee goes on a blind date in place of her friend to scare away the suitor, only to discover he is her company's CEO, who then makes her a marriage proposal.

title: What's Wrong with Secretary Kim
notes: A narcissistic vice-chairman of a major corporation is thrown into a panic when his highly capable secretary of nine years announces her resignation.

title: Shooting Stars
notes: A romantic comedy about the hardworking PR team, managers, and reporters who clean up the messes made by top stars in the entertainment industry.

title: King the Land
notes: An heir to a luxury hotel conglomerate who cannot stand fake smiles clashes with a cheerful employee who is known as the hotel's smile queen.

title: Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha
notes: A big-city dentist opens a practice in a close-knit seaside village, where she crosses paths with a charming, multitalented handyman who helps the residents.

title: Bitch x Rich
notes: A poor high school student becomes the sole witness to a murder at an elite high school and transfers there, clashing with the school's most powerful queen bee.

title: True Beauty
notes: A high school girl who is bullied for her appearance masters the art of makeup, transforming herself into a goddess and catching the eye of two popular boys.

title: Lovely Runner
notes: A passionate fan is devastated by the sudden death of her favorite idol star, only to find herself traveled back in time to their high school days, determined to save him.

title: My Demon
notes: A ruthless demon loses his powers after becoming entangled with a cold, arrogant chaebol heiress, and they enter into a contract marriage to protect each other.

title: Crash Landing On You
notes: A South Korean heiress accidentally paraglides into North Korea during a storm, where she is found and protected by a handsome North Korean army officer.

title: My Man Is Cupid
notes: A love fairy accidentally shoots himself with his own arrow and falls in love with a veterinary surgeon whose previous relationships always end in tragedy.

title: Bon Appetit Your Majesty
notes: A modern-day chef travels back in time to the palace kitchen, winning the heart and stomach of the cold emperor through culinary excellence.

title: Genie Make A Wish
notes: A young man saves a white cat, who turns out to be a cat spirit from another planet, who must fulfill one of his wishes before returning home.

title: Hierarchy
notes: An elite high school ruled by the top 0.01% of students is shaken when a mysterious transfer student arrives with a hidden vengeance.

title: Can This Love Be Translated
notes: A romantic comedy about a multilingual translator who falls into a complicated romance with a top global superstar who has completely opposite love languages.

title: Alchemy of Souls
notes: A powerful elite warrior mage whose soul is trapped in the body of a weak servant girl becomes the secret teacher to a troublemaking young noble.

title: Resident Playbooks
notes: A heartwarming slice-of-life medical drama following the daily lives, friendships, and realistic struggles of young obstetrics and gynecology residents.

title: 18 Again
notes: A middle-aged man on the brink of divorce suddenly finds himself transformed back into his handsome 18-year-old body, getting a second chance to fix his life.

title: Pursuit of Jade
notes: An historical fantasy romance about a determined noblewoman who enters the jade trade to restore her family's honor, finding love and danger along the way.

title: Sold Out on You
notes: A dramatic modern romance of betrayal and revenge where a billionaire heiress hides her identity to test her fiancé, only to find true love with a quiet bodyguard.

title: Spooky in Love
notes: An investigative occult romance drama where a ghost-seeing heiress and an ace prosecutor discover that a single touch unlocks their power as a duo to crack unsolved murders.
